thread:
ashley: heads-up — windows CI failing on the latest bazel toolchain bump, seeing missing cc toolchain during link. https://buildkite.com/r/infrabuilds/1234 :frowning:

buildbot: Build 4682 failed — log: https://ci/internal/builds/4682 (exit 1)

sam: I can take a look. Does this repro locally with `bazel test //... --config=windows`?

ashley: yes, reproduces. `bazel build //rl/**` stops with: 
```
ERROR: No usable toolchains found for types @["@local_config_cc//:toolchain"]
ERROR: While resolving toolchains for target //platform/windows:hello_world
```:confused:

olga: quick context — we rolled the gcc image yesterday (gcc11 -> gcc13). I think the cc_toolchain target was renamed in the image artifacts (cc-compiler -> cc-compiler-gcc13).

michael: @olga can you paste the mapping or the image diff? I'm on a short PTO but can at least triage if you tag me.

olga: pasted diff in the image repo: `images/gcc/BUILD` changed `cc_toolchain` -> `cc-compiler-gcc13`. I didn't update local_config_cc compat shim.

sam: this looks like toolchain_resolution mismatch. Short-term workaround: add `--override_repository=local_config_cc=/path/to/compat_local_config_cc` or set `--crosstool_top=@compat_local_config_cc//:cc-compiler`. Longer-term we should add a compat alias in the image or update our bazelrc.

ashley: can someone kick a rerun on the windows matrix? prefer not to rollback the image yet if we can patch.

buildbot: Rerun scheduled by sam — Build 4683 queued (windows-matrix).

michael: if rerun fails on the same shard, open a bisect request and tag #eng-infra + me. Include the minimal reproducer and the failing log.

ashley: adding minimal reproducer to the bug: `bazel build //platform/windows:hello_world --config=gcc`

sam: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with a tiny PR to add a compat alias in the image repo and update the bazelrc fallback. Will post PR link when ready.

buildbot: Rerun 4683 results: 2/3 shards passed, x86_64-2019 shard still fails with same toolchain error.

ashley: update — creating a bisect job for the failing shard now and attaching logs. Thanks all for the quick responses.

sam: noted, will continue with compat PR and ping when merged.
